summary: Apple SOS activation from an injured snowmobiler in California Park north of Hayden. Four RCSAR members rendezvoused with two West Routt Fire firefighters at the end of winter road maintenance on County Road 80, while another team member and a Steamboat Lake State Park Ranger snowmobiled in from Hahns Peak Village over Sand Mountain. The patient was packaged and transported on a freshly groomed route back to Steamboat Lake during a strong winter storm; the mission covered 68 miles on snowmobiles over 7.5 hours.
responding_agency: Routt County Search and Rescue; West Routt Fire Protection District; Steamboat Lake State Park Ranger
